primary: CHALLENGE RATING (Elo-style, official account-vs-account Challenges only)
eligibility: public visibility (user_preferences.leaderboard_visibility = 'public', default private) AND placed (≥ 5 rated matches AND ≥ 3 unique opponents)
tieBreakContract: 1 higher rating · 2 more rated wins · 3 fewer rated losses · 4 who reached the current rating first (last_rated_at asc) · 5 user id asc (stable, never shown)
aroundMe: 2 above, me, 2 below — public and placed accounts only; private means private (no approximate rank)
winPct: rated wins / rated matches (ties visible in W–L–T; not a tie-break)
signedOut: may read the public Top 100; never a private account
refresh: on page load and navigation; no polling; the My Rating module updates from the completion response
